other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Scheme is only for women and girl children.
Any individual woman can apply; a guardian can open a minor account on behalf of a girl.
No upper age limit; women of all ages are eligible.
Account must be a single‑holder type account.
A time gap of three months must be maintained between opening multiple accounts by the same holder.
Minimum deposit of ₹1,000 and deposits must be in multiples of ₹100.
No subsequent deposits are allowed after the initial deposit.
Maximum total deposit limit of ₹2,00,000 per account holder.
Withdrawal up to 40% of eligible balance allowed after one year but before maturity.
For minor accounts, guardian must submit the specified certificate for withdrawal.
benefits_summary: Provides a secure investment option for women and girls with a 7.5% annual interest compounded quarterly and a two‑year tenure.
